rationale: BTC wicked to 74,888, flushed about $1.0M of longs at 75.5k and bounced to 75.6k with no 1H close under 75,200. The 4H trend is still bearish and longs are crowded (ratio 3.0), so the add is a small 8 USDT spot tranche near support, keeping 24 USDT of cash for a deeper test of 74.1k.

message.text: Bought 8 USDT of spot at 75.6k near the 75.2k floor. A 1H close under 74,888 means stop buying and consider trimming; a 4H close above 76,555 reclaims the daily EMA200.

lesson.pattern: Wick below support that closes back above it
lesson.insight: The 74,888 wick was bought back within the hour and no 1H close printed under 75,200. Small tranches near the floor beat chasing the squeeze into resistance.
